title: Cristaux (1970). Gribouillis et calculs divers : notes manuscrites (s.d.).

deep.reconstruction:
This page is not Grothendieck's own mathematics. It is a typed, mimeographed Bourbaki draft (header 'n°382', page '-81-', printed upside down relative to the scan) whose verso Grothendieck used as scrap paper. His manuscript notes on the neighbouring pages are on Barsotti–Tate groups of height h with an action of a p-adic integer ring A, their Dieudonné modules, and isogeny classification. The typed text is part of a draft on jets for Bourbaki's 'Variétés différentielles et analytiques'. It belongs to the material that became the Fascicule de résultats section on jets; I am unsure of the exact section number.

Content, in modern terms:
- 7.1.7: For Y = K, the jet algebras P^k_x(X) assemble into a C^{r-k} vector bundle of algebras P^k(X) over X.
- 7.1.8: For a C^r manifold X, the first-order jets J^1_0(K,X)_x of curves through x identify canonically with T_xX. Their union gives the tangent bundle T(X), a C^{r-1} vector bundle.
- 7.1.9: A C^r map f: X→Y gives the k-jet prolongation x ↦ j^k_x(f), a C^{r-k} section of the source fibration J^k(X,Y)→X. The truncations J^k → J^{k'} (k' ≤ k) are morphisms over both X and Y.
- 7.1.10: With ℓ = k−k', the ℓ-jet at x of x ↦ j^{k'}_x(f) depends only on j^k_x(f). This gives a canonical C^{r-k} map J^k(X,Y) → J^ℓ(X, J^{k'}(X,Y)). In characteristic 0 it is an isomorphism onto a submanifold (the holonomic, or iterated-jet, embedding). For pure manifolds it is a morphism of fibrations over X.
- 7.1.11: Functoriality of jet spaces. Maps f: X→X' and g: Y'→Y induce u ↦ p^k(g)∘u∘p^k(f) on fibres. Globally this gives j^k(f,g): X ×_{X'} J^k(X',Y') → J^k(X,Y), of class C^{r-k}.

All of this is standard Ehresmann jet theory, written in Bourbaki's style.
errors: No substantive errors. Minor typographical point: in 7.1.10, 'x ↦ j^{k'}(f)' should read x ↦ j^{k'}_x(f).
The characteristic-zero hypothesis in 7.1.10 reflects Bourbaki's setting of K equal to R, C or an ultrametric field. It concerns the factorials in Taylor coefficients; this is not an error.

ideas.what: Jet bundles J^k(X,Y), the bundle of jet algebras P^k(X), the tangent bundle as 1-jets of curves, prolongation sections, the embedding of J^k into iterated jets J^ℓ(J^{k'}), and functoriality of jets
ideas.modern_name: Jet bundles and the holonomic embedding J^k ↪ J^ℓ(J^{k'})
ideas.usually_credited_to: C. Ehresmann (1951–53); systematised in Bourbaki, Variétés différentielles et analytiques, Fascicule de résultats
ideas.where_published: Bourbaki VAR R (jets section). This is a Bourbaki draft, not a Grothendieck text, though Grothendieck's EGA IV §16 treats the algebraic analogue (principal parts P^n).

deep.surprise_reason: The page is a typed Bourbaki draft on jets, used by Grothendieck as scrap paper. It contains standard, published material and no Grothendieck mathematics. The only historical note is the material fact that he wrote his Barsotti–Tate notes on the back of Bourbaki rédaction n°382.
transcription_corrections: The scanned page is a typed, mimeographed document printed upside down. It is not handwritten by Grothendieck.
In 7.1.11 the characterising formula is likely u ↦ p^k_{y'}(g) ∘ u ∘ p^k_x(f); the factor (g) appears to have been dropped in the transcription.
